note: Every image the site stack runs, by digest (D-12, D-20). images: third-party, ref is <host>/<repository>:<tag>@sha256:<64 hex>, the digest being the linux/amd64 image manifest, not the multi-arch index (spike S1, 47-01: that is the form that survives the bundle copy with its signatures); discovered by the compliance fit check. built: ours, built from deploy/images/<name>/image.json, digest null until the deploy-images job publishes it. release: published by another pipeline, digest null until published. A render injects the reserved unpublished digest for a null digest and the install refuses it. The site registry serves each image at <site registry>/<sitePath>, see deploy/bundle/lib/locks.mjs.
